step1_analysis.description: A basic NMOS differential pair with an NMOS tail current source. In the context of a continuous-time adaptive cable equalizer, this topology is typically used as a high-speed transconductor or gain stage.

paper_reference.title: A 0.18-m CMOS 3.5-Gb/s Continuous-Time Adaptive Cable Equalizer Using Enhanced Low-Frequency Gain Control Method

dc_power.description: DC power consumption of the differential stage

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming NBIAS=0.7V: I_tail = 0.5 * un*Cox * (W/L) * (Vbias - Vth)^2 = 0.5 * 270uA/V^2 * 10 * (0.7V - 0.42V)^2 = 1.05 mA. Power = 1.05 mA * 1.8 V = 1.89 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on a typical bias voltage of 0.7V and given SKY130 parameters. The paper's 80mW is for the entire chip.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2 * (I_tail/2) / Vov = 1.05mA / 0.62V = 1.69 mA/V. With a 2kOhm load added in the testbench, Gain = gm * RL = 3.38 V/V = 10.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen load resistor in the testbench. 2kOhm gives ~10.5 dB, which is reasonable for a single wideband stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * RL * CL). With RL=2kOhm and CL=40fF, f_3dB = 1.99 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Chosen load capacitance of 40fF to match the paper's reported bandwidth range for high-speed operation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for NMOS differential pair measuring DC power, AC differential gain, and 3-dB bandwidth.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

* DUT
XM2 OUTN INP N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 OUTP INN N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 N0 NBIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Loads (Added to complete the circuit)
R1 VDD OUTP 2k
R2 VDD OUTN 2k
C1 OUTP 0 40f
C2 OUTN 0 40f

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VNBIAS NBIAS 0 0.7

* Differential AC/Tran source
VINP INP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.1 100MEG)
VINN INN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.1 100MEG)

* VCVS to compute differential output
E1 OUT_DIFF 0 OUTN OUTP 1

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 100G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 20n
meas tran vpp_out_diff pp v(OUT_DIFF)

quit
.endc
